55/G.goal: Explain how a VR system renders three-dimensional objects into frame-buffer pixels by following the graphics pipeline and using object-representation techniques.
55/G.achieves: Provides the foundation for analyzing and optimizing the computational and display resources needed for VR rendering.

55/O1.goal: Describe how the three-dimensional graphics pipeline computes frame-buffer values by transforming objects through coordinate systems and rendering stages.
55/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a clear model of the VR rendering process, supporting later analysis of where computational work occurs in resource optimization.

55/O2.goal: Explain how three-dimensional objects can be represented for rendering using point-sample, boundary/mesh, spline, space-partitioning, and other specialized techniques, and the trade-offs among those choices.
55/O2.achieves: Lets the learner understand how object-representation choices shape rendering and resource requirements in VR systems.
